/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/2.source_en: The guide tracks every passenger's individual ship schedule and prioritizes return order if multiple ships sail at different times.

/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/3.source_en: The route is built with a 60-minute buffer for return-drive traffic.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/1.source_en: Yonggungsa has 108 stone steps down to the temple (skippable — upper viewing platforms exist).

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/2.source_en: Gamcheon is a hillside village with steep alleys and stairs throughout the photo route — traction shoes essential.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/3.source_en: Yongdusan ascent is covered by escalator from Gwangbok-ro; descent is by stairs.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/4.source_en: Jagalchi, ⟦G2⟧, ⟦G0⟧, and ⟦G1⟧ are flat and walkable.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/5.source_en: Total walking ≈5–6 km plus stairs across the full day.

/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/2.source_en: If your ship's port call is cancelled by the cruise line, full refund with cancellation documentation.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/0.source_en: The minimum age is 4. School-age children do best with the walking sections — Jagalchi's live fish and the Songdo skywalk are the reliable hits.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/1.source_en: Strollers are not viable at Gamcheon (stairs); the other stops accept them.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/2.source_en: Wheelchair users should consider the private cruise charter, which can be re-routed — Gamcheon's hillside is the bottleneck on this itinerary.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/preview.source_en: Minimum age 4. The route suits school-age children well; strollers do not work at Gamcheon.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/title.source_en: Surcharges, cancellation and who this tour is for

/practicalAccordionItems/6/content/0.source_en: Out-of-hours surcharge: if your ship requires a pickup before 08:00, or the tour finishes after 20:00, a surcharge of ₩10,000 per person applies and is paid on the day.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/content/1.source_en: Cancellation: free up to 24 hours before the tour starts. Inside 24 hours the booking is non-refundable.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/content/2.source_en: Minimum age: guests must be 4 years or older.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/content/3.source_en: Cruise passengers only: this tour is sold to guests arriving on a cruise ship calling at Busan. Bookings from travellers without a Busan port call are declined and refunded.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/content/4.source_en: Return timing: the day is built around your ship's all-aboard time, and the drop-off is scheduled ahead of it.

/practicalAccordionItems/6/preview.source_en: Pickup before 08:00 or finish after 20:00 adds ₩10,000 per person. Free cancellation up to 24 hours ahead. Age 4 and up. Cruise passengers only.
